decision_population: original confirmed cutoff roster identities only
future_identity_anchor: first observed same-season canonical roster identity strictly earlier than the target week
zero_proof: source-complete whole-NFL-week event absence plus no published player-stat row; same core source/rule/actor/game gates as roster-backed zero certificates
membership_policy: future membership may remain unknown; global scoring-event absence proves zero regardless of future team, bye, release or transaction; no future team or position is guessed
nonzero_proof: exact published canonical player-week stats with explicit team/position and completed scheduled game, corroborated by a PBP identity, plus ready event-family values and the existing exact scorer
new_rows: target_only_row=true; cannot enter the decision universe or redefine previously issued features
blocked: identity not known before target week
sample_interpretation: post-selection stress audit of unchanged forecasts; no retraining, fresh-holdout claim or automatic promotion
